system.description: Give motion to an illusion created with Ignis Fatuus or Ducomer. Spend a Blood Trait to grant the illusion movement you direct while concentrating; you may set it to repeat an action if your attention is needed elsewhere. Witnesses familiar with the imitated motion may retest the original Social Challenge if the motion seems unrealistic. Commanding an illusion out of your presence causes it to cease existing.
system.duration: As long as concentrating, or set to repeat
